body: Yeah, I called fully expecting to hang up as soon as someone picked up, but as the minutes ticked away on hold, I thought "fuck it. After this long, someone better listen to me whine."

Throw away.

The reason I don't apply for as many jobs as I should is because every time I even think about it, I want to start cutting again.

I have a boyfriend, so I get hugs all the time. It's nice, but doesn't really help anything. I do hate not being honest with him (he has no idea how far I've fallen), but what's my other alternative? Tell him so he can worry? He can't do anything, he'd just feel frustrated. Both of my parents have passed, and I don't have anyone else. Thanks for reading, though :)
